rule: A bedrock_inference node whose answer_format is exactly the string 'inspection' (no trimming, no case folding) is a Tunable_Node, whatever its anomaly_mode.
Every other node, an llm_inference node with answer_format 'inspection' included, is tunable exactly when the eligibility table's expectedTunable says so (Requirement 1.5, Property 1).
inspectionJsonInstruction: Respond with exactly one JSON object and nothing else: {"verdict": "pass"|"fail", "confidence": 0..1, "reason": "<one sentence>", "objects": [{"name": "<part>", "qc": "OK"|"NOK", "reason": "<short>", "bounding_box": {"x_min": <int>, "y_min": <int>, "x_max": <int>, "y_max": <int>}}, ...]} with one entry in objects per expected part.
